summary: Real BB verification of installed Host Monitor 0.1.2 covered compact popover and floating rows, dashboard identities, host cards, and health-badge indicators. Computed critical/attention/healthy backgrounds matched BB semantic tokens, labels remained visible and neutral, decorative dots remained aria-hidden, card halos stayed restrained, the sampler was running, and the movable trigger retained accessible fleet text with no pseudo-element notification dot. Four screenshots capture the exercised layouts; the live fleet's zero-offline limitation is documented and neutral fallbacks are executable-test covered.
